pitch: Weave festive cloth and gather harvest gifts under the full moon while mastering gratitude formulas.
topic: Chuseok Korean Harvest Festival, weaving contest, full moon, songpyeon rice cakes, and ancestors

arc.discovery: Phase 1: The Moonlight Radar spots festival artifacts (cloth loom, moon, rice cakes, ancestors) across ancient Korea.
arc.workbench: Phase 2: The Royal Weaving Loom requires teams to sequence festival steps, sort harvest items, and build sentences.
arc.karaoke: Phase 3: The Celebration Stage teleprompter guides team champions to deliver a 3-sentence harvest festival speech.

mechanics: Whole-class smartboard arcade where teams take turns tapping high-contrast buttons while desks vote with cards. Soft-fail system plays an encouraging chime and displays a hint with no point deductions. Team with highest stars earns the Golden Loom Trophy.

correct: The King smiles upon your team! 👑
softFail: Almost there! Look at the full moon clue! 🌙
Check the word ending and try once more! 💡
Think about who weaves the cloth! 🧵
Listen closely to the festival sound! 👂
feedback.levelUp: The Royal Weaving Loom glows gold! Level Up to Master Harvest Weaver! 🏆

smartboard.boardActions: Team representative taps large 72px answer pills, drags loom shuttles, or triggers voice hints.
smartboard.classParticipation: All students at desks display Red/Green cards or 1-4 finger votes simultaneously before the board player taps.
smartboard.version15min: 10 core rounds covering vocabulary matching and gratitude sentence building.
smartboard.version30min: Full 30-round tournament including listening challenges, story chronology, and live teleprompter pitches.
